top_signals.title: JPMorgan report finds dramatic jump in AI-themed ETFs — despite rough quarter
top_signals.summary: Wall Street is banking heavily on exchange-traded funds that give investors artificial intelligence exposure, according to JPMorgan Asset Management.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cheaper travel for millions with a third off fares
top_signals.summary: Millions of people will save a third on bus travel as Prime Minister Andy Burnham announces a cap on single bus tickets at £2 during his first week in office.
